title: Large Alchemical Reaction Pool
text: Build the model with eight Crystal Casings, three Infused Crystal Casings, two Mana Engines, and one each of Rough Alchemical Energy Core, Crystal Orb, Liquid Crystal Orb, Dream Crystal Block and Primitive Reaction Cauldron. Empty vessels, engines and upgrades, finish any reaction, then use one Infused Crystal on the Dream Crystal Block. Carry the completed machine with a Pocket Magic Bottle; it cannot be mined.

Open the control panel to inspect nine item types, four fluid types and four upgrades. A Recipe Control Upgrade can filter reactions. Base total fluid capacity is 40 B; storage upgrades expand it. Any block in the 3x3 catalyst area below may satisfy a reaction.

Side shafts accept rotation or electricity. Without Create, one own engine gives 100 seconds per reaction, two give 50. With Create, each input shaft reserves 512 SU at 16 RPM for base efficiency; doubling RPM doubles occupancy and efficiency. Electricity uses 512 FE/second per base rate, up to 16x. The higher power source wins; sources do not add together. Electric operation lights the stationary shafts and produces current sparks.

Matching recipes run independently. Catalyst recipes consume items first. Shared fluid need only meet the largest startup requirement, but each recipe consumes its own amount: keep the supply replenished. Full outputs pause only the affected reaction.

While powered, the green port exports one item per second; the blue port exports 500 mB per second. Output Upgrades filter both. Automatic export takes the bottom fluid first; handheld containers take the top fluid. Click a fluid layer to move it to the bottom. The top supports nine resonance nodes.

Insufficient reagent at a fluid installment fails that reaction. After more than half was consumed, failure causes a 20-block-radius blast dealing 30 magic damage and strong knockback, without breaking terrain.
